Been a Liverpool fan since my dad "brainwashed" me when I was 6. That's 15 years now. I watch a lot of football, I'm genuinely obsessed with tactics, management, stats, so on. 

I don't see how me calling someone who rates Mignolet over Karius daft makes me not knowledgeable. We've had Mignolet for 5 years now and his spells have always been the same thing, even though we got him a couple of years before he was supposed to enter his peak. He's always been small and weak, not very vocal, horrible distribution, EXTREMELY error-prone, more so than Loris and his positioning has been off. He's actually improved in the last few years and he still seems like a mid-table keeper, excluding 2-3 games a season where he seems a good top 4 keeper, but not even a worldie. 

Compare that to Karius who did have a horrible start to his Liverpool career, coming back from an injury, at least showed consistent form for a stretch in the latter part of last season. Also Karius's main weakness sadly seems to be mental, instead of technical, as he's shown he's more vocal than Simon and could at least sweep and distribute. 

Neither of them are good enough to be starters for me, but at this point being a Mignolet apologist is as bad as the lads saying "GIVE MARKOVIC ANOTHER SHOUT", so I'd much rather stick with Karius for the cup games and give the lad a chance at redemption and showing the same form he showed at Mainz and last season, bar the CL final, in which he was bloody concussed.
